title.zh: 为曼努埃尔·L·奎松举行国葬并建造安放其遗骸之陵墓拨付五万比索经费的法案
title.en: An Act Appropriating Fifty Thousand Pesos to Defray the Expenses of a State Funeral for Manuel L. Quezon and for the Erection of a Mausoleum to Contain His Remains
title.orig: An Act Appropriating Fifty Thousand Pesos to Defray the Expenses of a State Funeral for Manuel L. Quezon and for the Erection of a Mausoleum to Contain His Remains
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp 50.000 peso để chi trả chi phí tổ chức lễ tang quốc gia cho Manuel L. Quezon và xây dựng lăng mộ để an táng hài cốt của ông
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรงบประมาณห้าหมื่นเปโซเพื่อเป็นค่าใช้จ่ายในการประกอบพิธีศพแห่งรัฐสำหรับมานูเอลแอลเกซอนและเพื่อก่อสร้างสุสานเพื่อเก็บพระศพของท่าน
title.id: Undang-Undang Pengalokasian Lima Puluh Ribu Peso untuk Menutupi Biaya Pemakaman Negara bagi Manuel L. Quezon dan Pendirian Makam untuk Menyimpan Jenazahnya
title.ms: Akta Meluluskan Lima Puluh Ribu Peso untuk Menampung Perbelanjaan Jenazah Rasmi bagi Manuel L. Quezon dan Pembinaan Mausoleum untuk Menempatkan Jenazahnya

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1946/ra_2_1946.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sum of fifty thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to defray the expenses of a state funeral for Manuel L. Quezon, the late President of the Philippines, and for the erection of a temporary mausoleum to contain the remains of the great leader.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: July 19, 1946
